name: Atika K
text:
Absolutely delighted!
My husband ordered the ring for me and worked with Umar throughout the whole process, and we honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Umar was excellent, incredibly patient and so flexible, taking the time to understand exactly what we wanted and making sure everything was just right. It arrived to the UK super fast as well.

Thank you so much for your patience, professionalism and for creating such a beautiful piece. I’m absolutely thrilled with my ring! Highly recommend! ❤️

name: Najmeh Sajjadi
text:
I got my engagement ring made from
Vlora by Umer and I must say its the most beautiful ring I have ever seen. I also got our initials engraved inside. Every detail is so perfect and the work is so neat and precise. Highly recommend.

name: A.W. I
text: I got a custom made piece for myself and it was fantastically done. I highly recommend Vlora if you're looking to get anything custom made or purchase something ready made from their vast inventory of jewelry pieces.

name: M B
text:
I had a custom engagement ring made and I absolutely love it! The craftsmanship, finishing, and attention to detail are outstanding, the ring came out exactly true to the design. I’ve been wearing it nonstop since I received it.
Umer was a pleasure to work with and made the whole process enjoyable. I really appreciated the care, patience, and professionalism throughout. The fact that the pieces come with lifetime service and repair is a huge plus.
Highly recommend for anyone looking for unique, beautifully made custom jewelry. I’ll definitely be returning for future pieces.

name: Somaya Samra
text: Got my engagement ring custom made from Vlora, I was very impressed with the quality of the ring and the diamond was of great quality with a reasonable price!

name: Rishika Kasliwal
text: Got my engagement ring from them, amazing prices and wide variety of gold and diamond jewelry. Definitely recommend for any type of gold and diamond or silver ornaments.

name: Johanne Lumbo
text: The product is better than i expected. The experience was outstanding. Baba and all staff is very friendly and accomadating. Highly recommended!
